fees.note: Pinellas County's year-round rates for sites 86-236, which take every camping unit: $45.50 a night, $47.50 on the water, plus 6% tourist development tax and 7% state tax ($51.42 / $53.68). fees.note: James City County's camping fees, per site per night for up to 6 people (at most 4 adults): water and electric $48 (20/30-amp, 50-amp at a few), full hookup $60 - the two site types that take RVs. fees.note: City of Jacksonville: RV sites $27.24 a night including tax, which is $24.00 plus 13.5% (tents $22.70, $20.00 plus 13.5%).
